summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC (IHG) filed a Form 6-K reporting multiple open-market share repurchases executed between July 10 and July 14, 2026. The repurchases were conducted through Goldman Sachs International under a share buyback program authorized on February 17, 2026. Share amounts ranged from 2,044 to 40,000 daily, with prices between $157.10 and $166.45 per share. Total shares repurchased reduced the outstanding count to 148,613,282 shares. All repurchased shares are intended for cancellation, which incrementally increases earnings per share. The program is funded from existing cash reserves. Investors should monitor the program's completion and any impact on the company's share price and capital structure.
